hunks.baseline: Kwoooosh!
hunks.sol: Whoooosh!

hunks.baseline: At the fierce sound of air being torn apart overhead, the footsteps of thousands of people fleeing in every direction came to an abrupt halt. From among the tourists looking up at the sky, a dazed voice slipped past one person’s lips.
hunks.sol: A fierce rush of air sounded overhead. Thousands of people who had been screaming and fleeing in every direction stopped in their tracks. One tourist looked up at the sky and spoke in a daze.
“…Huh?”

hunks.baseline: It was not a question held by only one person.
hunks.sol: He wasn’t the only one wondering.

hunks.baseline: The civilians fleeing from the monster, the hundreds of support troops dispatched to stop it, and even the Peace Guild Hunters hurrying down the mountain in accordance with their Guild Master’s final wish—all of them watched the scene and thought of the same question.
hunks.sol: The civilians fleeing the monster, the hundreds of reinforcements dispatched to stop it, even the Peace Guild Hunters hurrying down the mountain to fulfill their Guild Master’s final wish—they all saw it and had the same question.

hunks.baseline: But each group had a different perspective and field of vision. While the civilians looked at the streak of light cutting across the sky with simple bewilderment, the high-ranking Hunters among the support troops sensed a powerful flow of mana in the distant sky for the briefest instant.
hunks.sol: But they saw it from different places and with different eyes. To the civilians, the streak of light crossing the sky was simply a mystery. The high-ranking Hunters among the reinforcements felt a powerful surge of mana far above them for the briefest instant.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, the Peace Guild members on the mountainside, much closer to the scene, realized how the streak of light overhead had appeared out of thin air.
hunks.sol: Closer still, the Peace Guild Hunters on the mountainside realized how the light had appeared out of thin air.

hunks.baseline: *……Teleport?*
hunks.sol: *…Teleport?*

hunks.baseline: Countless questions flashed through the minds of countless people. But the one who saw and felt the entire scene more clearly than anyone else was Kim Hwajong.
hunks.sol: Questions raced through countless minds. But no one saw and felt what was happening more clearly than Kim Hwajong.

hunks.baseline: The old butler, sitting at death’s doorstep, realized the identity of the blue streak spreading outward as it pressed down on the black mist made of magic power.
hunks.sol: On the brink of death, the old butler recognized the blue light spreading across the sky, pressing down on the black mist of magical power.

hunks.baseline: *That is…*
hunks.sol: *That’s…*

hunks.baseline: Something more destructive than anything else. Pure power.
hunks.sol: Power, pure and more destructive than anything else.

hunks.baseline: Flame more intense than sunlight and as fierce as the sun itself streaked across the sky as a beam of light. For a moment, within the dazzling flash so bright that he could barely look at it, a face seemed to pass across his blurred vision.
hunks.sol: Brighter than sunlight and as fierce as the sun itself, it streaked across the sky. For a moment, a face seemed to pass through Kim Hwajong’s blurred vision—a face somewhere inside that blinding light, too bright to look at directly.

hunks.baseline: Just as the smile at the corners of the old butler’s mouth deepened, the primordial monster that had risen from myth opened its enormous jaws toward the streak of light shooting at it.
hunks.sol: His smile deepened. The primordial monster risen from myth opened its enormous jaws toward the oncoming light.

hunks.baseline: Kwoooooom—
hunks.sol: Whoooooom—

hunks.baseline: The wind split apart, and the air scattered. Within the jaws opened wide enough to swallow a mountain, an energy resembling an abyss churned.
hunks.sol: The wind split. The air scattered. Inside jaws wide enough to swallow a mountain, an abyssal power churned.

hunks.baseline: But the streak of light did not stop. It grew sharper and larger, transforming into a blue-white flame that whipped through the air.
hunks.sol: But the light did not stop. It grew sharper and larger, becoming blue-white flame that surged through the air.

hunks.baseline: Gooooooong.
hunks.sol: Gooooong.

hunks.baseline: Fwoooooosh!
hunks.sol: Fwooooosh!

hunks.baseline: Darkness being torn to shreds beneath the blue sky.
hunks.sol: Darkness torn to shreds beneath the blue sky.

hunks.baseline: Blue-white flames racing forward while burning everything in their path, and one person’s voice ringing clearly through a dazzling world filled with silence.
hunks.sol: Blue-white flames burning through everything in their path. And in that dazzling, silent world, one voice ringing clear.

hunks.baseline: Space warped. The unprecedented flames that fell like a meteor pierced through Behemoth’s jaws before they could fully close.
hunks.sol: Space warped. Unprecedented flames fell like a meteor and pierced Behemoth’s jaws before they could close, passing through its body.

hunks.baseline: Watching the monster tilt to one side with a death cry like thunder, the old butler forgot his pain and laughed aloud.
hunks.sol: As the monster toppled with a death cry like thunder, the old butler forgot his pain and laughed aloud.

hunks.baseline: Even the greatest master in the world, even an ancient monster who seemed fit to appear only in myth, could not escape death. Especially not when a full-powered One Annihilation had pierced through its entire body via its mouth.
hunks.sol: Even the greatest master in the world could not escape death. Neither could an ancient monster that belonged in a myth. Not when a full-powered One Annihilation had entered through its mouth and pierced its entire body.

hunks.baseline: —Ho…w……
hunks.sol: —Ho…w…

hunks.baseline: Bewilderment and death settled at once in the eyes of the monster—a creature unlike any ever seen or heard of. Its enormous body, staring blankly at me, slowly tilted.
hunks.sol: Bewilderment and death settled together in the eyes of a monster unlike any I had ever seen or heard of. It stared at me vacantly as its enormous body slowly tipped over.

hunks.baseline: When the body emptied of life collapsed, the entire mountain trembled. At the same time, amid the enormous clouds of dust rising from every direction, I had to grit my teeth to endure the pain and fatigue surging over me like waves.
hunks.sol: The mountain shook when its lifeless body hit the ground. Huge clouds of dust rose all around me, and I gritted my teeth against the pain and fatigue rolling over me in waves.

hunks.baseline: *I must not collapse.*
hunks.sol: *I can’t collapse.*

hunks.baseline: One Annihilation was a double-edged sword that poured all of its caster’s power out at once.
hunks.sol: One Annihilation was a double-edged sword. It poured out all the user’s strength at once.

hunks.baseline: But not yet. At least not in a situation like this. I couldn’t collapse now. The one fortunate thing was that I possessed an unusual power unlike that of ordinary people.
hunks.sol: But I couldn’t fall yet. Not now. Fortunately, I had a power ordinary people didn’t.
Ding. Ding. Ding.

hunks.baseline: I barely steadied my staggering body.
hunks.sol: I barely managed to steady myself.

hunks.baseline: Leveling up was certainly one of the System’s most broken features, but it was not omnipotent unless its effects stacked. The fatigue accumulated in my body and mind was that severe, and my hands and feet tingled as though I had been electrocuted from the aftereffects of using One Annihilation.
hunks.sol: Leveling up was one of the System’s most broken features, but unless the effects stacked, it couldn’t fix everything. Too much fatigue had built up in my body and mind. The aftereffects of One Annihilation left my hands and feet tingling as if I’d been electrocuted.

hunks.baseline: But I couldn’t stop, and I couldn’t collapse. Along with the level-up, I drew up the internal energy filling my dantian and released it forward.
hunks.sol: Still, I couldn’t stop or collapse. I drew on the internal energy that had filled my dantian with the level-up and sent it surging forward.

hunks.baseline: The compressed air burst outward, scattering the dust cloud. Beyond the view that finally cleared, a rounded shape covered in pure white bones appeared.
hunks.sol: Compressed air burst outward, scattering the dust. At last I could see a rounded shape covered in white bones.

hunks.baseline: With every step I took across the devastated ground, my heart pounded violently. The breath escaping my lips was mixed with tension and fear that could not be hidden.

hunks.baseline: That was right. I was afraid of the person I was about to face.
hunks.sol: My heart pounded with every step across the ruined ground. I couldn’t hide the fear in my ragged breathing.

hunks.baseline: I was afraid he might look different from what I wished for. Afraid I might have to say goodbye before I was ready.
hunks.sol: I was afraid of what I’d find. Afraid he wouldn’t look the way I hoped. Afraid he would say goodbye before I was ready.

hunks.baseline: When I carefully placed my hand against it, the membrane made of bones scattered as though it were melting. And then I could finally see.
hunks.sol: I touched the barrier carefully. Its bones scattered as though melting away.

hunks.baseline: A grim-faced blond foreigner, and a middle-aged man with half-gray hair leaning against him, continuing to breathe as though each breath might be his last.
hunks.sol: Inside was a grim-faced blond foreigner. Leaning against him was a middle-aged man with half-gray hair, each faint breath seeming to be his last.

hunks.baseline: *This is…*
hunks.sol: *No…*

hunks.baseline: For a moment, it felt as though my heart had stopped.
hunks.sol: For a moment, my heart seemed to stop.

hunks.baseline: Though it lasted only an instant, it was not difficult to understand the situation. The bottle of top-grade potion rolling weakly at Skeleton King’s feet was empty, and strength was already slowly leaving the middle-aged man’s entire body, even though he appeared to have recovered without any visible problems.
hunks.sol: It took only a glance to understand. The top-grade potion bottle lying empty at the Skeleton King’s feet had rolled to a stop. The man appeared to have recovered without a mark on him, but strength was already draining from his body.

hunks.baseline: Feeling my vision grow distant, I opened my mouth.
hunks.sol: My vision swam.

hunks.baseline: “……Butler Kim.”
hunks.sol: “…Butler Kim.”

hunks.baseline: At my call, his half-closed eyelids trembled faintly. When our eyes met—his gaze on the verge of fading—his bloodstained lips curved gently upward.
hunks.sol: His half-closed eyelids fluttered at my voice. When his fading gaze met mine, his bloodstained lips curved into a gentle smile.

hunks.baseline: “Yes. I knew it would be you. That light was truly warm.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. I knew it would be you. That light was so warm.”

hunks.baseline: I gritted my teeth to hold back a groan. Butler Kim had already accepted everything that had happened to him. That was probably why his tone was different from usual.
hunks.sol: I clenched my teeth to hold back a groan. Butler Kim had already accepted what was happening to him. That was probably why he sounded different.

hunks.baseline: The man before my eyes was neither Butler Kim nor the Guild Master of the Peace Guild. He was simply a human being, Kim Hwajong, saying goodbye.
hunks.sol: The man before me was neither Butler Kim nor the Peace Guild’s Guild Master. He was simply Kim Hwajong, saying goodbye.

hunks.baseline: *I’m not ready yet.*
hunks.sol: *I haven’t accepted it.*

hunks.baseline: I couldn’t accept this sudden farewell. I had no intention of smiling as I sent him away. I would do anything to return the man who had become Kim Hwajong the human being in the face of death to Butler Kim, to the Guild Master.
hunks.sol: I couldn’t accept this sudden farewell. I wasn’t going to smile and let him go. I would do anything to bring Kim Hwajong back—to make him Butler Kim, the Guild Master, again.

hunks.baseline: “But I’m a little cold now. It was so warm earlier.”
hunks.sol: “But I’m a little cold now. I was so warm before.”

hunks.baseline: I took Kim Hwajong’s hand as he muttered in a faint voice and slowly sent Scorching Yang Qi into it as I answered.
hunks.sol: I took his hand and slowly sent Scorching Yang Qi into him.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: “It’s because we’re on a mountain. You’ll be warm soon.”
hunks.sol: “It’s because we’re up on the mountain. You’ll warm up soon.”

hunks.baseline: “Is that so?”
hunks.sol: “Will I?”

hunks.baseline: I forced a smile at his feeble question.
hunks.sol: I forced a smile.

hunks.baseline: “Yes. It’s still winter, after all.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. It’s still winter.”

hunks.baseline: Feeling the warmth seep into him, Kim Hwajong gave a faint smile.
hunks.sol: As the warmth seeped into him, Kim Hwajong smiled faintly.

hunks.baseline: “It really is. Just as you said.”
hunks.sol: “You’re right. It is warmer.”

hunks.baseline: “You’ll be all right. Don’t worry. I’ll take care of everything…”
hunks.sol: “You’ll be all right. Don’t worry. I’ll take care of—”

hunks.baseline: I could not finish the sentence. It was not only because my chest had tightened. The condition of his body, which I had examined with the internal energy I sent through him, had sealed my lips.
hunks.sol: My voice failed me, and not only because my chest had tightened. The internal energy I’d sent through him had shown me the state of his body.

hunks.baseline: *What in the world…*
hunks.sol: *What the hell…*

hunks.baseline: The human body contained an energy possessed from birth: innate qi. It was no different from the source and root of all energy. But almost none of that innate qi remained in Kim Hwajong’s body.
hunks.sol: Everyone was born with innate qi, the root and source of all the body’s energy. Almost none remained in Kim Hwajong.

hunks.baseline: No. Even that was slowly burning away.
hunks.sol: No. Even what little remained was slowly burning away.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang’s innate qi had also been damaged in Henan in the past, but it had never been this bad. In Kim Hwajong’s case, it had reached the point of no return.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang’s innate qi had been damaged in Henan, but not to this extent. Kim Hwajong’s condition was beyond repair.

hunks.baseline: I could tell enough just by observing his condition through my internal energy.
hunks.sol: I could tell from what my internal energy revealed.

hunks.baseline: The resolve with which he, Kim Hwajong, had faced Behemoth. What he had sacrificed to tie down the feet of the monster that had crawled up from the depths of darkness. And…
hunks.sol: What it had taken for him to face Behemoth. What he had sacrificed to hold back the monster that had crawled out of the darkness. And who he had burned his one and only life for.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: Who he had used his one and only life as kindling for.
“Young Master… Is Minwoo, is that child safe?”
hunks.sol: “Young Master… Minwoo. Is the boy safe?”

hunks.baseline: I answered his fading question in as bright a tone as I could manage.
hunks.sol: I made my voice as bright as I could.

hunks.baseline: “He’s safe. I caught a glimpse of him on the mountainside, and there’s nothing wrong with him.”
hunks.sol: “He’s safe. I caught a glimpse of him on the mountainside. He’s fine.”

hunks.baseline: “Yes. That’s a relief. A real relief.”
hunks.sol: “Good. That’s good. What a relief.”

hunks.baseline: *What is there to be so relieved about? You’re the one who ended up like this.*
hunks.sol: *What’s a relief? Look what’s happened to you.*

hunks.baseline: Just as I bit down firmly on my lips, along with the question I could not bring myself to speak, the thought Skeleton King sent out rang through my mind.
hunks.sol: I bit my lip rather than say it aloud. Then the Skeleton King’s thought sounded in my head.

hunks.baseline: —Though I absorbed the magic that had seeped into his bones and used a top-grade potion, it was already too late. Even after this body stepped in, there was nothing I could do.
hunks.sol: —*I absorbed the magical power that had seeped into his bones and gave him a top-grade potion, but it was already too late. Even I couldn’t save him.*

hunks.baseline: I knew. That was why I could not blame him. I knew he had done everything he could.
Though everything about him was an illusion created by illusion magic, the guilt and sorrow on Skeleton King’s face were real.
hunks.sol: I knew. I couldn’t blame him when he’d done everything he could. His entire appearance was an illusion made with magic, but the guilt and sorrow on his face were real.

hunks.baseline: —……I’m sorry, human.
hunks.sol: —*…I’m sorry, human.*

hunks.baseline: A question suddenly occurred to me. It was a question about everything happening to me right now.
Why was this guy apologizing?
hunks.sol: Suddenly I had questions about all of it.

hunks.baseline: Why was Kim Hwajong, who had been sitting at the table with us, eating and laughing as we talked only a few days ago, now lying here in a state beyond recovery?
hunks.sol: Why was he the one apologizing? How had Kim Hwajong, who’d eaten with us and laughed with us just a few days ago, ended up lying here beyond recovery?

hunks.baseline: And why had I been unable to stop it?
hunks.sol: And why hadn’t I stopped it?

hunks.baseline: I had power. The power to stop disasters and prevent tragic deaths.
hunks.sol: I had power. Enough to stop disasters and prevent senseless deaths.

hunks.baseline: It all began with the mysterious capsule that had suddenly intruded into my life one day. With it, I changed the fate I had been given and met new, precious connections. And now one of those connections was about to be severed. Someone was about to leave my side.
hunks.sol: It had started with a mysterious capsule that appeared in my life one day. It let me change the fate I’d been given and meet people who became precious to me. Now one of those bonds was about to break. One of those people was about to leave me.

hunks.baseline: Then why couldn’t I stop it?
hunks.sol: So why couldn’t I stop it?

hunks.baseline: In Shanxi, Henan, Sichuan, and Hubei. In Sichuan, and in Busan…
hunks.sol: In Shanxi, Henan, Sichuan, Hubei. In Sichuan, in Busan…

hunks.baseline: I had saved so many lives while traveling between the Murim and the modern world. So why couldn’t I save the one person about to leave before my eyes?
hunks.sol: I’d saved so many lives traveling between Murim and the modern world. Why couldn’t I save the one person dying in front of me?

hunks.baseline: It was then, as I sank into an irresolvable question and helplessness.
hunks.sol: I was sinking into that question, into helplessness, when—

hunks.baseline: A cold hand covered my trembling fist. Kim Hwajong looked at me with warm eyes and opened his mouth.
hunks.sol: A cold hand covered my trembling fist. Kim Hwajong looked at me, warmth in his eyes.

hunks.baseline: His blurred eyes and fading voice were nowhere to be found now. Seeing him warmly comforting me made my breath catch in my throat.
hunks.sol: His eyes were no longer clouded. His voice no longer sounded ready to fade. The kindness in his face caught the breath in my throat.

hunks.baseline: The last flame raised at the edge of death.
hunks.sol: A last flame flaring at the edge of death.

hunks.baseline: No. I still couldn’t let him go. Gritting my teeth, I sent even stronger internal energy into Kim Hwajong’s body. But contrary to my desperate wish, strength was slowly leaving the body that had reached its limit.
hunks.sol: No. I couldn’t let him go yet. I gritted my teeth and sent more internal energy into him, but his body was already at its limit. Strength continued to drain away.

hunks.baseline: I poured out the internal energy coiled in my dantian without holding anything back. I held open the acupoints that were slowly closing and fanned the flame dying deep within his body.
hunks.sol: I poured every bit of internal energy in my dantian into him. I held his slowly closing acupoints open and tried to feed the flame dying deep inside his body.

hunks.baseline: But despite my attempts, the end was approaching at a frightening speed.
hunks.sol: The end came closer anyway.

hunks.baseline: “It’s cold. I don’t know whether it’s because it’s winter, like you said, or because night has already fallen.”
hunks.sol: “It’s cold. I don’t know if it’s winter, like you said, or if night’s already fallen.”

hunks.baseline: That was impossible. Even now, an enormous amount of Scorching Yang Qi was flowing into his body, and the afternoon sun was still in the sky.
hunks.sol: It couldn’t be either. Scorching Yang Qi was still pouring into him, and the afternoon sun remained in the sky.

hunks.baseline: The cold and darkness that had come over Kim Hwajong were things only he could feel. Death that had reached his doorstep was freezing his body and blocking his view.
hunks.sol: Only Kim Hwajong could feel that cold and darkness. Death was freezing his body and drawing a veil over his eyes.

hunks.baseline: I mumbled haltingly toward the old butler, whose breathing had grown thin.
hunks.sol: I struggled to speak to the old butler as his breaths grew thinner.

hunks.baseline: “It’s all right. You’ll be able to see Team Leader Choi soon, so just trust me…”
hunks.sol: “It’s all right. You’ll see Team Leader Choi soon. Just trust me and…”

hunks.baseline: Thud.
hunks.sol: Clasp.

hunks.baseline: A hand seized my wrist. When I saw Skeleton King shaking his head with a dark expression, I finally realized.
hunks.sol: A hand closed around my wrist. The Skeleton King shook his head, his face grim.

hunks.baseline: No words or actions could stop one person’s final moment.
hunks.sol: At last I understood. Nothing I said or did could stop this.

hunks.baseline: Now…
It was time to let him go.
So that he—so that Kim Hwajong—could leave with even a little peace of mind.
hunks.sol: It was time to let Kim Hwajong go, so he could leave with whatever peace I could give him.

hunks.baseline: “Young Master… Is Minwoo, is that child safe?”
hunks.sol: “Young Master… Minwoo. Is the boy safe?”

hunks.baseline: His eyes had grown cloudy without my noticing. Though I had already heard the feeble question he muttered, it did not matter. I could answer him a hundred or a thousand times.
hunks.sol: His eyes had turned milky. He’d asked me already, but that didn’t matter. I could answer him a hundred times. A thousand.

hunks.baseline: “He’s safe. He hasn’t been hurt in the slightest.”
hunks.sol: “He’s safe. Not a hair on his head was harmed.”

hunks.baseline: “I want to see him. Just one last time…”
hunks.sol: “I want to see him. Just once more…”

hunks.baseline: “You’ll be able to. He’s already on his way here.”
hunks.sol: “You will. He’s already coming.”

hunks.baseline: “Is that really true?”
hunks.sol: “Is that… true?”

hunks.baseline: It was a lie. A bright red, pure white lie.
hunks.sol: It was a lie. A red lie, and a white one.

hunks.baseline: On the nameless mountainside swept by a wave of chaos, there were only the three of us and the monster’s corpse.
hunks.sol: The three of us and the monster’s corpse were alone on that nameless mountainside, still scarred by the chaos that had swept over it.

hunks.baseline: But Kim Hwajong could not tell that it was a lie. With only his cloudy vision and fading mind remaining, he reached a hand toward empty air.
hunks.sol: But Kim Hwajong could no longer tell. With his sight clouded and his mind fading, he reached into empty air as though the person he’d been waiting for would take his hand.

hunks.baseline: As though someone he had been desperately waiting for would take his hand.
Grab.
hunks.sol: Clasp.

hunks.baseline: At my call and the look that accompanied it, Skeleton King firmly took that hand. The old butler’s eyes curved like crescent moons, and a radiant smile spread across his lips.
hunks.sol: At my glance, the Skeleton King took it firmly. The old butler’s eyes curved like crescent moons, and a radiant smile spread across his face.

hunks.baseline: And then, in the next moment—
hunks.sol: And then—

hunks.baseline: The flame that had burned for one person and refused to go out for this moment finally guttered.
hunks.sol: The flame that had burned for one person, that had held on until this moment, finally went out.

hunks.baseline: The world went black.
hunks.sol: Everything went black.
